name: branch-separable-oracle-v1
question: Do branch values stabilize when every legal move receives an independent constrained-root compute budget?
status: frozen before new Experiment 018 oracle probing
source: The 24 root and 134 opponent-parent development contexts frozen before Experiment 016
oracle: Stockfish 18, one thread, 16 MB hash, one constrained legal root move per call, new-game boundary per branch
measurements: stable-important, stable-unimportant, and ambiguous label counts
prospective_gate: For both root and parent contexts: top move >=85%, top-3 Jaccard >=80%, within-25-cp Jaccard >=75%, 25/50/100-cp label agreement >=90%, and median regret difference <=25 cp
selection: A non-maximum tier must pass against both its next tier and the 160000-node-per-move audit endpoint; choose the cheapest eligible tier
external_diagnostic: Compare independent and shared MultiPV allocation at 40000 nominal nodes per move without using that comparison to waive the selection gate
development_guardrail: The audit endpoint cannot validate itself, and no finite Stockfish budget is perfect chess truth
